import bpy,numpy as np,json,struct,zlib,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parent.parent
cap=root/'captures/shipyard_painterly_20261112'
tex=root/'assets/coast/textures'
mats={m.name:m for m in bpy.data.materials if m.name.startswith('Shipyard_Painterly_')}
assert not bpy.context.scene.get('shipyard_painterly_complete_20261112'), 'Already edited; audit before repeating'
def mat(s):return mats['Shipyard_Painterly_'+s]
def principal(m):return next(n for n in m.node_tree.nodes if n.type=='BSDF_PRINCIPLED')
def lin(x):
 x=np.asarray(x,dtype=np.float32);return np.where(x<=.04045,x/12.92,((x+.055)/1.055)**2.4)
def pixels(im):
 w,h=im.size;a=np.empty(w*h*4,np.float32);im.pixels.foreach_get(a);return a.reshape(h,w,4)
written=[]
def save_img(name,a,color=False):
 # Author explicit sRGB bytes. Blender byte-image pixels are already encoded, not linear.
 rgba=np.rint(np.clip(a,0,1)*255).astype(np.uint8)
 h,w=rgba.shape[:2];raw=np.concatenate([np.zeros((h,1),np.uint8),rgba[::-1].reshape(h,w*4)],axis=1).tobytes()
 def chunk(tag,data):return struct.pack('>I',len(data))+tag+data+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(tag+data)&0xffffffff)
 data=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'+chunk(b'IHDR',struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',w,h,8,6,0,0,0))
 if color:data+=chunk(b'sRGB',b'\x00')
 data+=chunk(b'IDAT',zlib.compress(raw,6))+chunk(b'IEND',b'')
 path=tex/(name+'.png');path.write_bytes(data)
 im=bpy.data.images.load(str(path),check_existing=False);im.name=name;im.colorspace_settings.name='sRGB' if color else 'Non-Color';im.pack()
 written.append({'name':name,'size':[w,h],'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'median_rgb':np.median(rgba[:,:,:3].reshape(-1,3),axis=0).tolist()})
 return im
def smooth(a,b,x):
 t=np.clip((x-a)/(b-a),0,1);return t*t*(3-2*t)
def noise(u,v,nx,ny,seed):
 rng=np.random.default_rng(seed);g=rng.random((ny+1,nx+1)).astype(np.float32)
 X=u*nx;Y=v*ny;ix=np.minimum(X.astype(int),nx-1);iy=np.minimum(Y.astype(int),ny-1)
 fx=X-ix;fy=Y-iy;fx=fx*fx*(3-2*fx);fy=fy*fy*(3-2*fy)
 return (g[iy,ix]*(1-fx)+g[iy,ix+1]*fx)*(1-fy)+(g[iy+1,ix]*(1-fx)+g[iy+1,ix+1]*fx)*fy
def polygon(u,v,pts):
 inside=np.zeros(u.shape,dtype=bool);j=len(pts)-1
 for i in range(len(pts)):
  xi,yi=pts[i];xj,yj=pts[j]
  inside^=((yi>v)!=(yj>v))&(u<(xj-xi)*(v-yi)/(yj-yi+1e-20)+xi);j=i
 return inside.astype(np.float32)
def surface(m,col,height,rough,metal,dx,dy,strength=.4):
 nt=m.node_tree;p=principal(m)
 for n in list(nt.nodes):
  if n!=p and n.type!='OUTPUT_MATERIAL':nt.nodes.remove(n)
 p.inputs['Base Color'].default_value=(1,1,1,1);p.inputs['Roughness'].default_value=1;p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value=1
 gy,gx=np.gradient(height,dy,dx);nv=np.stack([-gx,-gy,np.ones_like(gx)],-1);nv/=np.linalg.norm(nv,axis=-1,keepdims=True)
 normal=np.ones_like(col);normal[:,:,:3]=nv*.5+.5
 orm=np.ones_like(col);orm[:,:,1]=rough;orm[:,:,2]=metal
 for suffix,arr in [('albedo',col),('normal',normal),('orm',orm)]:
  n=nt.nodes.new('ShaderNodeTexImage');n.image=save_img(m.name+'_V2_'+suffix,arr,suffix=='albedo')
  if suffix=='albedo':nt.links.new(n.outputs['Color'],p.inputs['Base Color'])
  elif suffix=='normal':
   nm=nt.nodes.new('ShaderNodeNormalMap');nm.inputs['Strength'].default_value=strength
   nt.links.new(n.outputs['Color'],nm.inputs['Color']);nt.links.new(nm.outputs['Normal'],p.inputs['Normal'])
  else:
   s=nt.nodes.new('ShaderNodeSeparateColor');s.mode='RGB';nt.links.new(n.outputs['Color'],s.inputs['Color']);nt.links.new(s.outputs['Green'],p.inputs['Roughness']);nt.links.new(s.outputs['Blue'],p.inputs['Metallic'])
def set_solid(s,rgb,rough,metal=0):
 p=principal(mat(s));p.inputs['Base Color'].default_value=(*lin(rgb),1);p.inputs['Roughness'].default_value=rough;p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value=metal
def recolor(s,fn,normal=None):
 m=mat(s);p=principal(m)
 for n in m.node_tree.nodes:
  if n.type=='TEX_IMAGE' and n.image and any(l.to_socket==p.inputs['Base Color'] for l in n.outputs['Color'].links):
   a=pixels(n.image);a[:,:,:3]=np.clip(fn(a[:,:,:3]),0,1);n.image=save_img(m.name+'_V2_albedo',a,True)
  if n.type=='NORMAL_MAP' and normal is not None:n.inputs['Strength'].default_value=normal
# Roof and wall share the existing 16-region atlas, UV and physical ribs untouched.
TW,TH=512,1024
v,u=np.mgrid[0:TH,0:TW].astype(np.float32)/np.array([TH-1,TW-1],np.float32)[:,None,None]
col=np.ones((TH*4,TW*4,4),np.float32);height=np.zeros(col.shape[:2],np.float32)
rough=np.zeros_like(height);metal=np.zeros_like(height);stats=[]
flake=[(.0,.06),(.08,.0),(.18,.03),(.23,.12),(.17,.16),(.21,.23),(.12,.28),(.08,.22),(.02,.25),(-.04,.18)]
for k in range(16):
 wall=k>=8;seed=7219+k*59
 wash=noise(u,v,4,6,seed);edge=noise(u,v,18,23,seed+1);brush=noise(u,v,13,37,seed+2)
 seam=noise(u,v,1,27,seed+3);runoff=noise(u,v,8,2,seed+4)
 left_width=.008+.033*smooth(.30,.65,seam)
 right_width=.005+.014*smooth(.35,.75,seam)
 lower_width=.012+.024*smooth(.30,.65,runoff)+.009*edge
 boundary=np.maximum(np.maximum(left_width-u,right_width-(1-u)),lower_width-v)
 rust=smooth(-.002,.002,boundary)
 # Ragged angular paint loss varies among UV regions and remains connected to seams.
 if k%4 in [0,2]:
  sx=.55 if wall else .8;sy=.31 if wall else .42
  shift=.16+.11*(k%3)
  pts=[(x*sx,y*sy+shift) for x,y in flake]
  patch=polygon(u+(edge-.5)*.009,v+(brush-.5)*.006,pts)
  rust=np.maximum(rust,patch*smooth(.2,.45,edge))
 if not wall and k in [1,4,6]:
  pts=[(.82+x*.39,.08+y*.55) for x,y in flake]
  rust=np.maximum(rust,polygon(u+(edge-.5)*.009,v,pts))
 base=np.array([.485,.595,.603] if wall else [.405,.510,.548])+[-.009,.005,.013,-.003][k%4]
 pigment=(smooth(.28,.39,wash)*.013+smooth(.60,.72,wash)*.012-.012)
 rgb=np.broadcast_to(base,(TH,TW,3)).copy()+pigment[:,:,None]+(brush[:,:,None]-.5)*.006
 rustcolor=np.array([.527,.362,.261])+(wash[:,:,None]-.5)*np.array([.045,.028,.018])
 rgb=rgb*(1-rust[:,:,None])+rustcolor*rust[:,:,None]
 # Two restrained fastening runoff marks, broken in length.
 stain=np.exp(-((u-.085)/.014)**2)*smooth(.73,.78,v)*(1-smooth(.89,.94,v))
 rgb-=stain[:,:,None]*np.array([.026,.021,.016])
 yy=(k//4)*TH;xx=(k%4)*TW;s=np.s_[yy:yy+TH,xx:xx+TW]
 col[s][:,:,:3]=rgb
 height[s]=(brush-.5)*.000045-rust*(edge-.5)*.000055
 rough[s]=(.77 if wall else .69)+wash*.04+rust*.10
 metal[s]=(.045 if wall else .19)*(1-rust)+.006*rust
 stats.append({'tile':k,'role':'wall' if wall else 'roof','rust_fraction':float(np.mean(rust>.5))})
surface(mat('RivetedSheetSteel'),col,height,rough,metal,.96/TW,4/TH,.42)
# Mid-value cold grey iron keeps frame separation without near-black outlines.
S=512;v,u=np.mgrid[0:S,0:S].astype(np.float32)/(S-1);n=noise(u,v,5,7,807);b=noise(u,v,23,17,808)
c=np.ones((S,S,4),np.float32);r=smooth(.76,.88,n)
c[:,:,:3]=np.array([.295,.351,.355])+(n[:,:,None]-.5)*.025
c[:,:,:3]=c[:,:,:3]*(1-r[:,:,None])+np.array([.42,.31,.25])*r[:,:,None]
surface(mat('HeavyOxideIron'),c,(b-.5)*.00006,.72+n*.06,.18*(1-r)+.008*r,1/S,1/S,.32)
# Restore authored grey-blue paint after the previous double conversion.
recolor('BlueSaltPaint',lambda rgb:np.array([.466,.567,.575])+(rgb-rgb.mean(axis=(0,1)))*.45,.28)
# Warm limestone: broad mineral washes, quiet faces, fine shallow pores.
S=1536;v,u=np.mgrid[0:S,0:S].astype(np.float32)/(S-1)
a=noise(u,v,5,6,831);b=noise(u,v,31,33,832);f=noise(u,v,170,177,833)
c=np.ones((S,S,4),np.float32)
c[:,:,:3]=np.array([.454,.451,.410])+(a[:,:,None]-.5)*np.array([.033,.029,.024])+(b[:,:,None]-.5)*.008
pores=smooth(.80,.93,f)*smooth(.45,.65,b)
c[:,:,:3]-=pores[:,:,None]*.014
surface(mat('CutWeatheredStone'),c,(b-.5)*.00014-pores*.00032,.84+f*.035,np.zeros_like(f),1.6/S,1.6/S,.55)
set_solid('AgedMortar',[.39,.385,.342],.88)
# Preserve the atlas role differences, directional grain and end grain.
for key in [n.removeprefix('Shipyard_Painterly_') for n in mats if '_Worked_' in n]:
 if key=='Worked_BoatWood_Lit':
  recolor(key,lambda rgb:rgb*.97+np.array([.031,.025,.013]),.68)
 else:
  boost=np.array([.034,.025,.010]) if 'frame' in key else np.array([.042,.031,.015])
  recolor(key,lambda rgb,b=boost:rgb*.96+b,.64)
# The workbench was especially dark after the earlier colour conversion.
recolor('Props_WorkbenchOak',lambda rgb:rgb*.78+np.array([.191,.153,.104]),.52)
# Keep the red binding and canvas zones, lower weave contrast without erasing seams.
def cloth(rgb):
 target=np.where((rgb[:,:,0]-rgb[:,:,1]>.08)[:,:,None],np.array([.43,.235,.16]),np.array([.65,.606,.50]))
 return rgb*.70+target*.30
recolor('Props_AgedCanvasRing',cloth,.55)
recolor('Props_WorkedIron',lambda rgb:rgb*.75+np.array([.085,.10,.10]),.45)
recolor('HarborCraft_CraneForgedIron',lambda rgb:rgb*.70+np.array([.10,.115,.115]),.5)
set_solid('Props_WornSteel',[.40,.45,.445],.48,.45)
set_solid('RecessShadow',[.235,.27,.265],.90)
set_solid('DustyWorkshopGlass',[.37,.455,.449],.43,.035)
bpy.context.scene['shipyard_painterly_complete_20261112']=True
(cap/'material_manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'geometry_changed':False,'palette':'weathered blue-grey iron, quiet warm stone and honey-brown workshop wood','sheet_regions':stats,'textures':written,'color_encoding':'Explicit sRGB bytes in PNG; no repeated gamma conversion; loaded and packed afresh'},indent=2),encoding='utf8')
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=bpy.data.filepath)
print('MATERIALS_SAVED',len(written),'textures','rust_fraction',float(np.mean([s['rust_fraction'] for s in stats])))
